0022600029.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 2nd in the Northwest and 5th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the Southwest and 2nd in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with the Thunder on a one-game win streak and Memphis coming off a loss. Oklahoma City is missing Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), Nikola Topic (back) and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Thunder won their last meeting 117-116 in Memphis on January 9, 2026, and swept the 2025-26 season series 3-0.
